text:
```yaml
name: Claude PR Critique

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  claude-critique:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run linting and type checking for web
        run: |
          cd web
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck

      - name: Run tests for web
        run: |
          cd web
          npm test

      - name: Run linting and type checking for apps
        run: |
          cd apps
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck

      - name: Run linting and type checking for electron
        run: |
          cd electron
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck

      - name: Run tests for electron
        run: |
          cd electron
          npm test

      - name: Request Claude critique
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: "Please provide a brief critique of this pull request. Focus on code quality, potential issues, and best practices. Keep your response concise and actionable."
          model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"
          timeout_minutes: 5
```
